🇲🇽🏭 <u>BAJA CALIFORNIA HITS #3 NATIONALLY FOR LOWEST INFORMAL EMPLOYMENT — INEGI</u>

INEGI confirmed Saturday that Baja California now ranks third in the country for lowest labor informality, with formal employment expanding under Governor Marina del Pilar Ávila Olmeda. Trump's tariffs were supposed to break Mexico's border industry — instead BC's export base, MSME support, and strategic location have kept it dynamic and competitive. Formal jobs with social security and benefits are the exact opposite of what Washington predicted nearshoring rollback would produce. The border economy isn't collapsing. It's consolidating.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>THE NUMBERS THE EMPIRE CAN'T STAND: 49% HOMICIDE DROP, 2.5% UNEMPLOYMENT, $23.5B FDI — WHY WASHINGTON WANTS THIS GOVERNMENT GONE</u>

Contralínea lays it out: under Sheinbaum's first year, FDI hit $23.591 billion, unemployment dropped to 2.5%, minimum wage is up 154% since 2018, homicides fell 49%, 29 new hospitals built, 42.8 million Mexicans covered by social welfare. Washington's response? CIA operations in Chihuahua without federal authorization, Standard & Poor's-led credit downgrades, "cognitive warfare" through US corporate media, and right-wing collaboration with foreign powers. Author Josafat Hernández: defending sovereignty against imperialism is the central task of the Mexican left. A government that delivers for its people is exactly the kind of government the empire targets.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM NAMES IT: ULTRADERECHA SECTORS ARE SABOTAGING THE MEXICO-US RELATIONSHIP</u>

President Sheinbaum directly accused far-right sectors on both sides of the border of running disinformation operations to wreck bilateral relations: "hay sectores de ultraderecha que son los que están buscando que no haya buena relación entre el gobierno de México y el de Estados Unidos." She named the LA Times and NYT — outlets running hit pieces since the AMLO years — and welcomed DHS denying a fabricated "special permit" claim targeting Sonora governor Durazo and Tamaulipas governor Villarreal. The PAN already filed an international complaint accusing AMLO of nonexistent narco ties. Same Brazil 2014 playbook, exposed in real time.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>KATIA ITZEL GARCÍA MAKES HISTORY: FIRST MEXICAN WOMAN TO ARBITRATE A MEN'S WORLD CUP</u>

The 33-year-old UNAM grad served as fourth official in Japan vs Netherlands at the Dallas stadium — becoming the first Mexican woman ever to arbitrate at a men's FIFA World Cup. One of 52 referees designated by FIFA for the 2026 tournament, García also officiated at the 2024 Paris Olympics, became the first woman to direct a men's Gold Cup match, and won Mexico's National Sports Award. From UNAM's Faculty of Political and Social Sciences to the world stage — public university producing world-class talent the empire can't manufacture.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>IRAN-US PEACE FRAMEWORK SIGNED JUNE 19 IN SWITZERLAND — HORMUZ TO REOPEN</u>

After 12 days of US-Israeli bombing failed to topple the Islamic Republic, Washington and Tehran reached a peace framework Saturday — to be formally signed June 19 in Switzerland — extending the ceasefire 60 days, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and including Lebanon. Trump claimed it would bring "paz y seguridad" to the Middle East. The strategic survival of Iran under coordinated attack by two nuclear powers — and Tehran dictating terms at the table — is the actual headline. The empire bombs, then negotiates the framework Iran's resistance forced.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>BANXICO RECORTA PRONÓSTICO 2026 A 1.1% — MÉXICO SIGUE EN POSITIVO PESE A LA GUERRA COMERCIAL DE TRUMP</u>

Banxico cut its 2026 GDP forecast from 1.6% to 1.1%, citing Q1 weakness and uncertainty around Trump's T-MEC renegotiation. But notice what wasn't in the report: no recession. Peso still strong. Inflation back in Banxico's target range at 3.94%. April exports hit a record $50.7B to the US. Mexico absorbing Washington's economic warfare and still growing.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>ISSSTE MILPA ALTA ALCANZA 99.5% DE ABASTO DE MEDICAMENTOS — 40 MIL DERECHOHABIENTES BENEFICIADOS</u>

The ISSSTE Family Medicine Clinic in Milpa Alta hits 99.5% medication supply with 365 codes stocked, after Martí Batres' delivery of a 498-liter cold-chain refrigerator. Benefits 40,000 affiliates across Milpa Alta, Tláhuac, Xochimilco. Nationally, ISSSTE's 766 pharmacies averaged 97% supply Oct 2025-Mar 2026, with no farmacia below 90%. The institution Peña gutted is being rebuilt.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>CONTRALÍNEA: HSBC, ELBIT Y FANUC — LAS CORPORACIONES QUE LUCRAN CON EL EXTERMINIO PALESTINO</u>

Contralínea, citing UNRWA: 6 million Palestinian refugees still wait to return to their land, 78 years after the Nakba. Ruth Dávila Figueroa (CIDE) names the BDS targets — HSBC, Elbit Systems, Fanuc — corporations cashing in on occupation and genocide. Mexico's foreign policy still hasn't broken every link to the apartheid state. It should.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>CONTRALÍNEA: PARA ROMPER LA DEPENDENCIA YANQUI, MÉXICO DEBE GRAVAR A SLIM Y SUSPENDER LA DEUDA</u>

Contralínea names the numbers: "The Yankee invader left us with only 1.9 million km² out of 4.5 million." Mexico pays 1.6 trillion pesos a year in public debt service — more than the entire health budget. Corporations pay 2.4% of total income tax; individuals carry 35%. Sovereignty needs structural cuts — tax the billionaires, suspend the debt, cut every tie with Israel.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>CANCILLER CUBANO: "RUBIO NO TIENE INTERÉS REAL" EN ENTREGAR LOS 100 MDD; BLOQUEO CAUSA 5 MIL MDD ANUALES</u>

Cuba's FM Bruno Rodríguez calls out Washington's farce: of the $100M in "humanitarian aid" the US announced, only $3M arrived in over 6 months, another $6M took 4 months. Meanwhile the economic blockade and energy embargo cost Cuba over $5 billion every year. "Wouldn't it be more humanitarian to lift the illegal energy blockade?"
